title: Iraq RF Spectrum Dataset: Handcrafted Features Extracted from RTL-SDR IQ Recordings
role: future feature-based sensing/classification evaluation, not IQ demodulation
raw_iq_availability: Publisher points to separate related Zenodo records; links under inspection
limitations: The published feature tables must not be treated as raw IQ waveforms.
Source category labels do not establish protocol decoding or CRC validation.
Split evaluation by recording/day and track overlap with the source IQ records; window-level random splits can leak near-duplicate context.
